steps.python:
t = ${tasks}
assert [x['name'] for x in t] == ['go2_velocity', 'g1_rough'], t
g = {x['key']: x for x in t[0]['groups']}
assert list(g) == ['run', 'observation', 'action', 'command', 'reward', 'termination', 'event', 'algorithm'], list(g)
assert all(p['readonly'] for p in g['observation']['params'] + g['action']['params']), g
assert sum(p['dims'] for p in g['observation']['params']) == 48 and t[0]['robot'] == {'links': 13, 'joints': 12}, t[0]
assert t[0]['module'] == 'nuka.train.tasks', t[0]

v = ${v0}
assert not v['ok'] and v['errors'][0]['path'] == 'scene' and 'the scene has 0' in v['errors'][0]['message'], v

c = ${c1}
assert c['changed']['run'] == {'num_envs': 256, 'max_epochs': 6, 'save_every': 2}, c['changed']
assert c['changed']['algorithm'] == {'minibatches': 5}, c['changed']
assert [e['path'] for e in c['errors']] == ['algorithm.minibatches'], c['errors']

import pathlib
c = ${c2}
assert c['task'] == 'go2_velocity' and c['config']['run']['num_envs'] == 256 and 'algorithm' not in c['changed'], c
assert len(list(pathlib.Path(r'${profile}', 'train').glob('*.json'))) == 1

s = ${s0}
assert s['name'] == 'smoke' and s['state'] == 'starting' and s['alive'], s

s = ${s1}
print('TRAINED', {k: s[k] for k in ('state', 'epoch', 'frames', 'fps', 'reward', 'best_reward', 'checkpoints', 'error')})
assert s['state'] == 'finished' and s['epoch'] == 6 and s['max_epochs'] == 6 and s['checkpoints'] >= 4, s
assert s['error'] is None and 'MAX EPOCHS NUM' in s['log'], s['log']

m = ${m1}
assert [r['epoch'] for r in m['rows']] == [5, 6] and m['next'] == 6, m

import os
k = ${k0}['checkpoints']
print('CHECKPOINTS', [(c['kind'], c['epoch']) for c in k])
assert {c['kind'] for c in k} == {'best', 'epoch', 'final'}, k
assert all(os.path.isfile(c['policy']) and os.path.isfile(c['checkpoint']) and c['obs'] == 48 and c['actions'] == 12 for c in k), k

r = ${r0}
assert [x['name'] for x in r] == ['smoke'] and r[0]['state'] == 'finished', r

import time
p = ${p0}
s = p['status']
print('PLAY', p['policy'], {k: s[k] for k in ('obs_dim', 'act_dim', 'robots', 'device', 'rate_hz')})
assert p['policy'].endswith('.nkml') and s['loaded'] and s['obs_dim'] == 48 and s['act_dim'] == 12 and s['robots'] == 1, s
t = time.monotonic()
while time.monotonic() - t < 3.0:
    app.update(True)
assert app.policy.status()['action_norm'] > 0.0

import time
t = time.monotonic()
while app.actions.run('train.status').get('epoch', 0) < 2:
    assert time.monotonic() - t < 120.0, app.actions.run('train.status')
    app.update(True)

s = ${s2}
k = app.actions.run('train.checkpoints')['checkpoints']
print('STOPPED', s['state'], s['epoch'], [(c['kind'], c['epoch']) for c in k][-2:])
assert s['state'] == 'stopped' and 2 <= s['epoch'] < 5000, s
assert k[-1]['kind'] == 'final' and k[-1]['epoch'] == s['epoch'], k
